settings.heading: Contact Us
settings.body:
For order questions, returns, shipping issues, product support, account questions, or damaged/incorrect items, contact us at [Support Email].

For faster help, include your order number, email used at checkout, product name, clear description of the issue, photos or videos if the item is damaged/defective/incorrect, and tracking number if available.

Estimated response time: [Insert Response Time]. Response times may be longer during weekends, holidays, launches, or high support volume.

Do not send products to any address unless we first approve the return and provide return instructions. We do not publish a personal home address for returns. Approved returns may be sent to a return center, commercial mailbox, fulfillment partner, supplier-authorized return location, or another approved business return destination.
